name: kyber
description: What the household apps share: scripts that read the consumer's .kyber/config.json, the working rules that travel, and the declared stack.

scripts.check: git ls-files '*.mjs' | xargs -I{} node --check {} && git ls-files '*.py' | xargs python3 -m py_compile && git ls-files '.githooks/*' | xargs -I{} bash -n {}
